definitions.feature_cutoff: strictly_before_decision_timestamp; daily market context uses prior completed close
definitions.overlap_policy: cluster overlapping same-rule same-symbol events before effective sample counting

entry_semantics.pullback_limit: trigger when low <= level after publication
entry_semantics.breakout: trigger when high >= level after publication
entry_semantics.conditional: trigger only when explicit condition is satisfied
entry_semantics.next_session: use next-session open only when no better timestamp/entry semantics exist

price_source_policy.conflict_policy: mark invalid/conflict and do not score
